title: Skills
summary: Install skills (folders with a SKILL.md) and let Jev choose which one the agent should use for each request. Jev reads the request and the skills' names and descriptions, picks at most one, and tells the model to follow it.
usage: Open Settings › Skills (or Ctrl+K › Settings › Skills) and click Install from folder, choosing a skill folder or a folder of skills; you can also paste the text of a SKILL.md. Turn a skill off to take it out of the choice, or remove it to delete the copy. Each request shows a Skill step when one was picked.
